name: Narcissus
title: Christian in Rome
summary: Narcissus was a Christian in Rome whom Paul sends greetings to in his letter to the Romans. He is mentioned along with his household, suggesting that he was a wealthy man with servants and family members who were also believers.

keyEvents.title: Greeting from Paul
keyEvents.description: Paul sends greetings to the believers in Narcissus' household in Rome, indicating that there was a group of Christians associated with his home.
